strings.W3: Shrani besedilo, ki ga pogosto tipkaš, in ga tapni na tipkovnici v kateri koli aplikaciji
strings.W5: Kopiraj shranjeno sliko z enim tapom in jo prilepi kamor koli
strings.W7: Brez računa in interneta. Cutlingi se sinhronizirajo le prek tvojega iClouda.
strings.A2: Vklopi Cutling v nastavitvah, nato se vrni v aplikacijo
strings.A5: Videoposnetek korakov v nastavitvah: tapni Tipkovnice, vklopi Cutling, vklopi Dovoli polni dostop in tapni Dovoli
strings.F2: Cutling brez tega tipka tvoje besedilo
strings.F4: Polni dostop omogoča tipkovnici kopiranje shranjene slike in dodajanje kopiranega
strings.F6: Cutling nima računa in se nikoli ne poveže z internetom. Ne bere, kaj tipkaš.
strings.F8: iOS pokaže isto opozorilo za vsako tipkovnico, ki to zahteva, ne glede na njeno delo
strings.T4: Pridrži tipko %@ spodaj, izberi Cutling in tapni Preizkusi me
strings.T5: Cutling je vtipkal. Vse je nared.
strings.N2: Polja za izpolnjevanje in precej več prostora
strings.N5: Iz urejevalnika dodaj prazno mesto ali današnji datum in ga ob vsakem vnosu cutlinga izpolni
strings.N9: Tapni oblikovan cutling in vnese se kot drugi; pridrži ga, da kopiraš oblikovanje
strings.N12: Pridrži tipko z globusom na tipkovnici in izberi Cutling
strings.N14: Tapni cutling in vnese se tja, kjer pišeš
strings.N16: V Cutling deli besedilo, povezave ali slike iz katere koli aplikacije

back.W3: Save text you often type and tap it on the keyboard in any app
back.W5: Copy a saved image with one tap and paste it anywhere
back.W7: No account and no internet. Cutlings sync only through your iCloud.
back.A2: Turn on Cutling in settings, then return to the app
back.A5: Video of the steps in Settings: tap Keyboards, turn on Cutling, turn on Allow Full Access and tap Allow
back.F2: Without it Cutling types your text
back.F4: Full Access lets the keyboard copy a saved image and add what was copied
back.F6: Cutling has no account and never connects to the internet. It does not read what you type.
back.F8: iOS shows the same warning for every keyboard that asks, regardless of what it does
back.T4: Hold the %@ key below, choose Cutling and tap Try me
back.T5: Cutling typed it. All is ready.
back.N2: Fields to fill in and considerably more room
back.N5: From the editor add a blank or today's date and fill it in each time you type the cutling
back.N7: Save up to %1$@ texts and %2$@ images
back.N9: Tap a formatted cutling and it types like the others; hold it to copy the formatting
back.N12: Hold the globe key on the keyboard and choose Cutling
back.N14: Tap a cutling and it is typed where you are writing
back.N16: Share text, links or images into Cutling from any app

notes: Informal ti, matching the locale's existing setup strings. Unsure: 'tapni' kept from the locale; N10 reuses the formal 'Dobrodošli' form of the existing welcome string. sl-SI is identical to sl in Localizable.strings.
